summary: Hongli Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing board changes: effective September 29, 2026, Chairman Jie Liu resigned the chairmanship (remaining CEO) and director Chenglong Yang resigned all board and committee positions, both citing personal reasons with no disputes. The board appointed Michael Weichun Zhang, 57, a private-equity managing partner, as chairman immediately, with a standard director offer letter and indemnification agreement. No price, stake, premium, advisor, or closing terms are stated. Watch for whether the abrupt chairmanship reshuffle signals strategy or governance shifts, and any subsequent activist or capital-allocation developments.
